fields.quoted_span: Within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy, a landlord must return the security deposit, plus interest earned less deductions, to the tenant
fields.note: Each element of the requirement appears in the guide: the 1.5x cap, pet deposit and prepaid rent counting toward the cap, the 2.5x limit at lease start, the 10% yearly increase limit, trust and no commingling, interest-bearing accounts, notices, the 7% tenant remedy, the return timing and methods, double damages, the new-owner duty, the penalties, and the disorderly persons offense. One small wording difference: the guide says 'ten or less units', while the rule says 'fewer than 10'.

fields.quoted_span: Any additional yearly security deposit increase may not exceed 10% of the current security deposit.
fields.note: The 1.5x cap, the 2.5x limit at lease start, the 30-day return, and double damages for wrongful withholding are all stated in the guide.
The field is empty and the guide gives no effective date for the Security Deposit Law.

fields.quoted_span: Within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy, a landlord must return the security deposit, plus interest earned less deductions, to the tenant
fields.note: The guide presents the law as current. It shows no repeal, sunset, or pending status.

fields.quoted_span: The exception is an owner-occupied two-, or three-family dwelling.
fields.note: The guide also supports the opt-in by written request after 30 days, the inclusion of mobile homes, and the 125-day seasonal exemption from the interest-bearing account section.

fields.quoted_span: one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 )
fields.note: The guide cites 46:8-21.2 for the deposit cap. The aliases (46:8-19, -19.1, -21, -21.1, -21.4, -21.5, -25, -26) also appear in the guide.
